title: Custom indicators/trading bot/ML
author: Bixby_3
selftext:
I will create you a custom TradingView indicator or MT5 trading bot — from a simple alert script to a full multi-confluence dashboard.

Background: I build algo trading systems for XAUUSD (Fibonacci retracement + EMA trend filter setups, SMC/Smart Money Concepts with Time Series Momentum filtering, and ML-based models using LightGBM with proper walk-forward validation). I've done the full cycle myself — backtesting, parameter optimization, and live demo deployment — so I'm not just coding blind from a spec, I understand what actually needs to go into a working strategy.

What I can build:  
\- Custom Pine Script indicators (order blocks, CHoCH/BOS, liquidity levels, FVG detection, setup graders)  
\- ICT/SMC-style tools with auto-invalidation logic  
\- MT5 Python bots with prop-firm compliance guards  
\- Strategy backtesting and optimization  
\- ML-based signal models (feature engineering, proper leak-free validation)

Portfolio includes an SMC Toolkit (7-confluence dashboard), a multi-timeframe liquidity levels indicator with auto-deletion of broken levels, and an ICT Rejection Block indicator with auto-invalidation.

Happy to share examples or do a small free tweak first so you can see the work before committing. DM me or comment what you're looking for and I'll quote you.
